description: Prepares a spoken mock interview on Presentr Practice for a specific job and returns a link to start it. Use it when the user wants to practise or prepare for a job interview for a role or a job posting. Pass the job title; pass the company and the job posting text only if the user gave them. The interview runs on Presentr Practice in the user's browser: an AI interviewer asks the questions out loud and follows up, and the user answers by voice or by typing. Starting it needs a Presentr Practice account with a verified email (signing in with Google verifies it at once); the link opens in any browser. Give the user the link; do not run the interview in the chat.

company.description: The employer, only if the user named one.

job_posting.description: The job posting text exactly as the user pasted it, only if they did.

job_title.description: The job the user is interviewing for, e.g. "Dental Assistant".

name: create_practice_interview

url.description: Link that opens the prepared interview on Presentr Practice.

title: Create a practice interview
